newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Baxter has 99.3 pct of Immuno after offer.
newsitem.headline: Baxter has 99.3 pct of Immuno after offer.

text.p: Baxter International Inc holds rights to 99.33 percent of share capital and 99.71 percent of voting rights in Swiss blood products maker Immuno International AG after a public offer, CS First Boston said.

CS First Boston said Baxter, which took over a controlling stake from Immuno's main investors before the January 13 public offer, also now had rights to 88.83 percent of a 75 million Swiss franc issue of convertible Immuno bonds.

U.S. group Baxter, headquartered in Deerfield, IL, and Immuno will form the world's biggest blood products manufacturer when they merge under a plan approved in December by the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.
CS First Boston said after the offer ended on February 14, a total of 5,576 bearer shares and convertible bonds with a nominal value of 8.375 million Swiss francs remained public.
"A decision will be made later about possibly delisting both titles," the statement said.
